skills.name: Pact of Everlasting Harmony
skills.description: Recalls the past. A young Tianzi appears  and exchanges a promise.  Good effects on allies.  *Critical Rate +30% (5 sec) *Skill Resistance +30% (5 sec) *Evade Rate +30% (5 sec)

skills.name: No Hesitation in My Heart!
skills.description: Quickly approaches the enemy  and slashes multiple times with a sword.  Bad effects on enemies.  *ATK x 2500% Area Damage  *Enemy Physical DEF -40000 (6 sec) *Enemy Magical DEF -40000 (6 sec)

abilities.name: Group: CODE GEASS Lelouch of the Rebellion
abilities.description: CODE GEASS Lelouch of the Rebellion Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and ATK buffs will be applied in battle.  You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Mineral Restore
abilities.description: Some of the Mineral used to produce that Ranger is restored when they are defeated.
